name: yaak
description: Build, save, and send API requests with the yaak CLI

interface.shortDescription: Build, save, and send API requests with Yaak
interface.longDescription: Teaches the agent the yaak CLI: create workspaces, requests, environments, and auth, send one request or a whole suite, chain responses, and import OpenAPI, Postman, Insomnia, Bruno, or cURL. Requests are saved to Yaak, so you can open them in the desktop app.
defaultPrompt: Create Yaak requests for every route in this API
Import this OpenAPI spec into a Yaak workspace
Send my Yaak requests against staging and report failures
